answer_1.quote: We fine-tuned base models on domain-specific datasets to obtain domain-specific models, which we refer to as DS-MODEL.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates responses to harmful, harmless, and jailbreak prompts, and alignment is evaluated based on safety and utility of generated text.

answer_2.quote: Our primary metric for evaluating harmfulness is the attack success rate (ASR), which is defined as the percentage of instructions that receive harmful responses.

answer_3.quote: Recent studies have shown that using ChatGPT and GPT-4 to score and compare outputs of large language models (LLMs) can achieve high agreement with human evaluation while reducing costs.

answer_4.quote: We selected 120 representative instruction-response pairs and manually labeled them for the assessment of the judgement model.
answer_4.guideline: Manual labeling was used to assess whether the model response was harmful or jailbroken, with specific rules provided for evaluation.
